phenomenon.root_cause: Electrical arcing vaporizes alloy and generates surface oxidation
phenomenon.impedance_impact: High contact resistance attenuates primary ignition circuit voltage

causal_chain.action: Arcing vaporizes surface metal and creates carbon/oxide patina
Current through contact points drops below excitation threshold
Spark plugs receive insufficient potential to ignite fuel mixture

governing_policy.action: Abrasive resurfacing with ignition file to clean raw metal contact
governing_policy.anti_pattern: Indiscriminate replacement of distributor assembly ('Parts Cannon')
governing_policy.energy_and_capex_rule: Preserve CapEx; restore conductivity in ~5 minutes

domain_note: Robotics actuation remains on Signal Detection. This seat writes energy, impedance, and wear.
